subject: Q2 close: playbook, stage hygiene, and final forecast
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@brightapps.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightapps.com
Date: 2026-06-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 commitment and procurement timeline

Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the quick replies earlier. We're aligned internally on the business case and I can get procurement moving as long as we have the final prices and an estimated start date for the dedicated capacity (we need to include that in the PO).

A few asks from our side so we can commit this week:
- Final unit pricing and any short-term credit you can offer for an accelerated start (we plan to go live by 7/15).
- Contract term and billing cadence for the first 90 days.
- A sample statement of work / scope of access for our security team.

I've attached our PO template (BrightApps_PO_template.pdf) — procurement will need that completed to begin processing. If it's easier, we can sign a short-term addendum and roll into an annual contract after go‑live.

Can we lock in a 30‑minute sync tomorrow morning to get the signatures moving?

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Director of Partnerships | BrightApps
emily.zhao@brightapps.com

Subject: Re: Q2 commitment and procurement timeline

Emily — appreciate the clear asks. Laura and I spoke about this in the AM; here's a short playbook to get BrightApps across the finish line this week.

Immediate (today):
- Laura: confirm final per‑token/per‑embed pricing and send a one‑page pricing summary (we'll include any short-term credits there).
- Ben: prepare the Q2 rollup spreadsheet with committed vs best‑case numbers for this opp (I put a slot for a 7/15 start).
- Marcus: prepare a minimal SOW template for procurement (security overview + data handling bullets).

Mutual action plan for BrightApps:
- 6/29: Pricing + SOW sent to Emily.
- 6/30: BrightApps returns signed PO or requests minor edits.
- 7/01: Final signatures + ops kickoff planning.

Can everyone reply with status updates in this thread so finance can take tomorrow's snapshot for the forecast? Emily — if your procurement team needs an exec contact, loop in whoever you need and we'll prioritize.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — North America | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Q2 pipeline hygiene — what needs to be updated before the 7/1 finance snapshot

Team — quick internal checklist before we hand the numbers to finance: please update stages in Salesforce and confirm the committed amount you want in the Q2 snapshot. Small definitions: 
- "Committed": signed PO or firm exec approval with a PO expected within 48 hours.
- "Verbal": LOI / oral commitment where procurement is still sorting. Report as best‑case but not committed.

I need replies in-thread with these two pieces per opp: Opportunity ID, Stage (Committed/Verbal/Best‑Case), Amount to include in commited total. If we don't get a signed PO by EOD 7/01, we move the line to best‑case for forecast.

Priority opps to confirm (from the rollup):
- BrightApps — $180,000 (current ask: commit for 7/15 start)
- StratusHealth — $95,000 (PO in legal review)
- NovaRetail — $60,000 (needs updated security questionnaire)

Also call out any blockers (security, legal, integrations). I don't want surprises when finance closes the book for the day tomorrow.

Thanks — Vivek

(attachment: none)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Q2 pipeline hygiene — what needs to be updated before the 7/1 finance snapshot

Vivek / all — quick status:
- BrightApps (00T5g00000A1B2C): Stage = Committed (verbal + PO template in flight), Amount to include as committed = $150,000. Procurement indicated they want the 90‑day billing cadence; Emily is chasing legal for a relaxed signature path.
- StratusHealth (00T5g00000A1B2D): Stage = Verbal, Amount = $95,000 (do not include as committed until legal confirms).
- NovaRetail (00T5g00000A1B2E): Stage = Best‑Case, Amount = $60,000 (security questionnaire requested).

Attached the Q2 rollup with two versions: sheet tab A = committed-only; tab B = committed+verbal. Use tab A for the finance snapshot unless instructed otherwise.

Ben

Date: 2026-07-01T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 commitment and procurement timeline — final snapshot and next steps

Emily / procurement / team — thanks for moving quickly. Final update and asks: 

1) Rollup and snapshot
- Finance will take the committed-only snapshot (per Ben's tab A) at 6pm PT today. That will include BrightApps at $150k committed. If BrightApps can upload a signed PO or email confirmation by 5:45pm PT, finance will include the full $180k ask; otherwise we'll record $150k as committed and show $30k in best‑case.

2) Deliverables we will send tonight (attached):
- redwood-accepted-offer.pdf — short form offer with pricing and 90‑day billing cadence.
- SOW template (Marcus will send separately to procurement).

3) Next steps for ops
- If procurement needs an exec escalation to speed signature, Emily, tell me who to call and I will prioritize.
- Ops kickoff scheduled tentatively for 7/16 if PO in by 7/08.

Emily — appreciate you circulating the PO template. I'll follow up once finance confirms what made the committed snapshot.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
